task_instance: Exercise the skill's core deliverable by resolving the Cull repository and reporting its current release state (the minimal non-mutating entry point of the orchestrated release cycle, e.g. the 'check' phase), as a step toward orchestrating a verified release.
blocker_detail: The orchestrator SKILL.md delegates every phase to five sibling skills (cull-release-check, cull-release-prepare, cull-release-publish, cull-release-verify, cull-release-recover), which install-suite.sh also enumerates as the suite. None of those five skill directories exist next to SKILL.md; only cull-release is present, so the orchestrated phases cannot be invoked. Compounding blockers that also prevent the deliverable even if those files existed: (1) the target Cull software repository is absent (no current origin matching the expected owner/name, no absolute override env var, and no copy under the home ai_projects path), and phase-contracts.md requires the repo's own 'npm run release:cull' orchestrator which is not present and must not be reimplemented or stubbed; (2) the core stated deliverable is verified distribution through a code-hosting service and a package-manager tap, which requires pushing tags, triggering remote release workflows, and committing to an external tap, all of which are external-service writes forbidden by the safety rules and would need account credentials.
evidence: Read SKILL.md, references/phase-contracts.md, references/release-lessons-2026-09.md, scripts/install-suite.sh in the skill folder. `find` over the skill repo shows only the cull-release directory; a per-skill existence check confirmed cull-release-check/prepare/publish/verify/recover are all MISSING. Checked for the Cull target repo: home ai_projects/cull does not exist and the CULL_REPO env var is empty. install-suite.sh lists the six-skill suite but five members are absent, so the orchestrator has nothing to call. No deliverable produced; stopped before any mutation.
